stock.description: Ever Reach Group (Holdings) Company Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise, with its primary focus on real estate development and property investment within mainland China. The company's activities include constructing and marketing various types of properties, such as residential dwellings, commercial establishments, parking facilities, and storage units. Additionally, it offers a suite of services including property trading, residential leasing, real estate brokerage, rental management, and property-related advisory. The firm was established in 1992 and is headquartered in Xuchang, People's Republic of China.
